# course-builder

> A Claude Code plugin that researches real articles and YouTube video transcripts, cross-references facts across multiple sources, and synthesizes structured study courses with narrative arcs, actionable frameworks, and full source attribution.

course-builder is a Claude Code plugin with one skill (`/course-builder:course`) and two agents (course-builder + innovation-scout). The skill asks the scoping questions and orchestrates the run; course-builder reads 10-25+ real articles via web fetch, validates facts by quorum (3+ sources = high confidence), and writes a self-contained Markdown course with beginner-to-advanced progression; innovation-scout adds a chapter of unexplored opportunities.

## Key capabilities

- Research-driven: reads real articles and YouTube video transcripts, not just LLM knowledge
- Fact validation by quorum (cross-referencing 3+ independent sources)
- Three depth levels: Quick (8-12 sources), Standard (15-25), Deep (25-40 with recursive sub-research)
- Narrative arc from foundations to advanced
- Actionable frameworks in every lesson
- Per-lesson source attribution with links
- Innovation scout agent that finds unexplored opportunities
- Incremental mode to add modules to existing courses
- Persistent agent memory for user preferences, failing domains and past courses
- PDF export via pandoc + Typst
- Research transparency metadata (sources read, failures, quorum stats)

## Installation

In Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add klausners/course-builder`, then `/plugin install course-builder@course-builder`.
